cohort: The study included 79 consecutive patients who underwent [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT.
finding: [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 uptake from medical/invasive interventions without foreign body placement (FBP) appears to be time-dependent, nearly always absent beyond 8 months post-intervention, but is frequently present for years with FBP.
followup_time: Several years (median time-interval post-intervention to FAPI-PET was 47.5 months)
